description: Link Trip→Stay→Place / Event→Person (graph, not prose). link_type accepts documented aliases (e.g. participant → event_person); unknown values error instead of silently becoming "other". Pass status=confirmed|rejected to record a human decision on an existing (often inferred) edge. ($0.10; API key required)

link_type.description: trip_stay | trip_flight | stay_place | event_place | event_person | transaction_trip | event_event | other. Aliases: participant/participants/attendee/attendees → event_person.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

status.description: Confirm or reject an existing edge (usually an inferred one). Requires the edge to already exist.
